name: stack-dotnet
description: Opinionated .NET/C# stack pack for the sdlc framework: net10.0, Blazor, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Aspire orchestration with container-based local emulation, Azure PaaS (not containers) for deployed environments, Terraform as the sole source of truth for deployed infrastructure, MSTest, coverlet coverage, and scaffold files. Includes an ML.NET variant.
